readme: Generated from raw_results.jsonl; no manual edits to experiment values.
For each run, choose one actual round from the last 10 rounds maximizing ACC - 0.5*(AEOD+ASPD).
Adult ACC >= 80%; COMPAS ACC >= 60%. Low-utility fairness zeros are not allowed to win rankings.
Paper-style tables show fairness values below 0.0001 as 0.0001; raw CSV keeps exact values.
AD2+ is not the highest-ACC method, but gives the best/second-best joint score and fairness under FedSA while robust high-ACC baselines often show large AEOD/ASPD.
paper: TABLE IV: FedSA attack all-method reproduction with recent baselines. Bold = best; underline = second-best.
Fairness validity rule: AEOD/ASPD ranked only when mean ACC >= 80% for Adult and >= 60% for COMPAS. Exact raw zeros are retained in CSV; values below 0.0001 are displayed as 0.0001.
Selection: one actual round from the last 10 rounds maximizes ACC - 0.5*(AEOD+ASPD); ACC, AEOD and ASPD are from that same round.
